sources.title: OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati is stepping down
sources.quote_checked: I'm stepping away because I want to create the time and space to do my own exploration. | the momentum we've built | It's hard to overstate how much Mira has meant to OpenAI, our mission, and to us all personally.

sources.title: Former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati finally unveils her Thinking Machines Lab startup and a leadership team stacked with former OpenAI colleagues
sources.quote_checked: AI systems more widely understood, customizable, and generally capable | Knowledge of how these systems are trained is concentrated within the top research labs

sources.title: Mira Murati steps back into the spotlight, carefully
sources.quote_checked: When I wake up in the morning, I am not thinking about how to kill the competitor.
